notes: Reached via Chrome connector only (per project rule); robots.txt has generic Shopify agent-access policy, no Claude-specific disallow, 'Allow: /' throughout. Site canonicalizes to https://ikiru.in/ (no www) once loaded, so all links use that host to match the verified/actual URLs. Ikiru is a real, substantial furniture retailer, not a small side line: top nav has a dedicated 'Furniture' department (distinct from Lighting & Lamps, Decor, Home Fragrances, Kitchenware, Utility) whose landing page (https://ikiru.in/collections/furniture) reports 1263 products and lists 13 sub-departments matching the mega-menu exactly: Tables, Chairs, Seating, Cabinets & Sideboard, Chest of Drawers, Wardrobe, Storage Shelves & Racks, Dining Furniture Set, Beds, Sofas & Recliners, Outdoor Furniture, Bar Furniture, TV Unit. Tree source: the Furniture mega-menu DOM (div.mega-menu__list, verified against the landing page's own facet header list -- both agree). This is the same site the prior Home-Decor pass (archive c293) extracted, whose notes explicitly listed 'all Furniture collections (TV Unit, Tables, Chairs, Sofas, Beds, Wardrobe, Cabinets, Pooja Chowki, Trunk, Plant Stand)' as excluded from that decor-only run -- confirming furniture is a genuine, populated department here, not absent. Depth: recorded the deepest nav leaves (41 leaves under 9 grouping parents, plus 4 standalone leaves with no children: TV Unit, Wardrobe, Cabinets & Sideboard, Chest of Drawers). Qty method: same-origin fetch() of /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250, paged to exhaustion, counting unique product IDs (the exact method the prior pass validated for this Shopify store, since products_count is known-unreliable project-wide). Corroborated once: enumerated Side Table = 307, matches the collection page's own rendered 'main' region 'to display' by cross-check against http rendered header text '307 products' exactly (the page's left-rail 'Product Category' facet showed a lower sub-tag figure of 279 for the literal 'Side Table' tag, which is a facet within the collection, not the collection total -- 279+20+1+1+5+1=307, so the facet undercounts the whole page and the enumerated/rendered total of 307 was used, matching Rule 1's rendered-header priority). Sum of all leaf qtys (2077) exceeds the Furniture landing total (1263) because of normal Shopify multi-tagging -- a product can sit in more than one sibling leaf collection (e.g. an item tagged both Side Table and a Selective Edition); each leaf is still reported at its own exact, independently-verified count, and no qty here is a sum/estimate. Excluded per project scope: Beds & Mattresses were not merged (site cleanly separates Beds furniture from a Mattresses department elsewhere, not touched); Pooja Chowki, Trunk, Plant Stand, and other decor-adjacent furniture-ish stands seen in the prior decor pass were not found as furniture nav nodes in the current mega-menu and were not added speculatively. No blocks encountered; no MANUAL REVIEW flags needed -- every leaf returned a clean rendered-consistent count.
